verdict.rationale: pnpm can pin and auto-switch the Node.js version per project via the packageManager/devEngines fields, and can install that runtime without nvm or shell hooks, which partially covers 'right tool version activates automatically.' However this activation triggers on first pnpm invocation, not on directory entry per se (no shell-hook/cd-triggered mechanism is described), and there is no evidence of automatic environment-variable activation at all. missing for 10: directory-entry (cd) triggered activation mechanism, environment-variable auto-loading, independent confirmation of this behavior beyond docs.
